panel.title: Qurans and school
panel.text: Children chant their letters on slates in the side room. In the corner an old copyist writes the Quran by hand, one careful page a day.
panel.quran: Pay for a Quran to be copied for a family
panel.quran_line: Written by hand and given to a home that has none.
panel.school: Pay a child's school for a year
panel.school_line: Slate, ink, and a year of lessons with Idris.
panel.secret_label: Ask Idris to keep it quiet
panel.secret_locked: (You can give in secret once you have read the scholar's first page.)
panel.first_child: Faris sits in the front row with a slate on his knees. The orphan from the quay is learning to read.
panel.more_child: Another child from the quay lanes joins Idris's school.
panel.quran_done: The copyist dips his pen. In a few weeks a family will have the Quran in their home.
panel.public: Idris tells the room who paid.
panel.secret: Idris tells no one who paid.
